notes: From a proper read of GoPro's documentation. The camera test was showing the Open GoPro API version and calling it the firmware; it now reports the camera's real firmware and model, and warns if the firmware is older than the 01.70.00 that GoPro require on a HERO9. Live view start is also more careful, matching GoPro's own sequence. Run Test camera once to see the firmware, then go to step 3 Calibrate.
